query:
UPDATE community_members SET (id, 
account_id, 
member_id, 
rating, 
collabs, 
rewards, 
first_collab_date, 
last_collab_date, 
force_hydrate, 
priority, 
alignment, 
trust, 
contribution, 
advocacy, 
judgment, 
rootstock_joined_at, 
comment, 
created_at, 
updated_at) = ((CASE $2::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $3 ELSE id END), (CASE $4::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $5 ELSE account_id END), (CASE $6::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $7 ELSE member_id END), (CASE $8::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $9 ELSE rating END), (CASE $10::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $11 ELSE collabs END), (CASE $12::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $13 ELSE rewards END), (CASE $14::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $15 ELSE first_collab_date END), (CASE $16::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $17 ELSE last_collab_date END), (CASE $18::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $19 ELSE force_hydrate END), (CASE $20::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $21 ELSE priority END), (CASE $22::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $23 ELSE alignment END), (CASE $24::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $25 ELSE trust END), (CASE $26::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $27 ELSE contribution END), (CASE $28::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $29 ELSE advocacy END), (CASE $30::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $31 ELSE judgment END), (CASE $32::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $33 ELSE rootstock_joined_at END), (CASE $34::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $35 ELSE comment END), (CASE $36::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $37 ELSE created_at END), (CASE $38::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $39 ELSE updated_at END)) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id as "id!: i32", 
account_id as "account_id!: String", 
member_id as "member_id!: String", 
rating as "rating!: CommunityMemberRating", 
collabs as "collabs!: i32", 
rewards as "rewards!: String", 
first_collab_date as "first_collab_date!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
last_collab_date as "last_collab_date!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
force_hydrate as "force_hydrate!: bool", 
priority as "priority!: bool", 
alignment as "alignment!: Option < i32 >", 
trust as "trust!: Option < i32 >", 
contribution as "contribution!: Option < i32 >", 
advocacy as "advocacy!: Option < i32 >", 
judgment as "judgment!: Option < i32 >", 
rootstock_joined_at as "rootstock_joined_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
comment as "comment!: Option < String >", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime", 
updated_at as "updated_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >"
